parameters.name: ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the secret. If this parameter is set to true, the secret cannot be recovered.

Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default value)

parameters.name: RecoveryWindowInDays
parameters.description: Specifies the recovery period of the secret if you do not forcibly delete it. Default value: 30. Unit: Days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms delete-secret --secret-name secret001 --force-delete-without-recovery false --recovery-window-in-days 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms DeleteSecret --region cn-hangzhou --SecretName secret001 --ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery false --RecoveryWindowInDays 10
